verdict.rationale: CrewAI's core abstraction is the Crew, a group of agents that collaborate on tasks under sequential or hierarchical processes. Agents can delegate to coworkers, and Flows coordinate multiple Crews and coding tasks in one event-driven workflow with shared state. A community user also reports building a working multi-agent crew. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of hierarchical manager/handoff semantics (the hierarchical process description is truncated in the evidence).

support.subject: As a developer, I can orchestrate multiple agents — handoffs, subagents, or crews — inside one workflow

citations.quote: A crew in crewAI represents a collaborative group of agents working together to achieve a set of tasks. Each crew defines the strategy for task execution, agent collaboration, and the overall workflow.

crew = Crew(
    agents=[agent1, agent2],
    tasks=[task1, task2],
    process=Process.sequential  # or Process.hierarchical
)
Communicate and collaborate with other agents
Flows allow developers to combine and coordinate coding tasks and Crews efficiently
Built a crew of AI agents with CrewAI to categorize emails, apply labels, draft responses, send Slack alerts, and delete low-priority mail.
